_readme: Published profit after costs (million ₫ per ha) for each crop key that rotations.json 'profit' maps a calendar code to. value = the figure, or the midpoint of a range (the range is in 'place'); unit 'crop' = per crop, 'year' = per year (the shrimp season, one a year). year = harvest year (winter–spring 2023–24 = 2024). kind: survey | government | university | cooperative | farmer | news (a reporter's area figure with no named source). Rule: Mekong Delta, 2020–2026, profit after costs, a stated unit, from a survey, government, university or cooperative source (not a single farmer, not a news figure with no named source); anything else has fallback: true and is used only where the key has nothing better. build.py takes the median of each key's qualifying figures when it has at least 2, otherwise of all its figures. loss: share of a key's profit lost; view typical (applied in both views) or elnino (El Niño view only); applies 'all' or 'salt_months' (only when a month of that crop is in the pin's salt months). A loss whose source note says 'team estimate' has no source for that number. Each source quote was checked by Claude. Upland crop keys: watermelon, maize, mungbean (no checked figure yet: its income is not scored). The Nov 2026 search found only two mungbean figures, both in one Báo Cà Mau article (3 Apr 2020, baocamau.vn/nong-dan-that-mua-dau-xanh-a3129.html): one is from before 2020 and the other is a drought-year profit worked out as revenue minus cost with the công size not stated, so neither is used; upland_other holds figures for other or unnamed upland crops, kept for the README cross-check and not scored.
